notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE – Global Shipping Simulator
notes.content:
🛳️ GLOBAL SHIPPING SIMULATOR
The new version is now available for everyone!

🎉 Global Shipping Simulator has officially launched as a public release on Steam!
[hr][/hr]✅ What this update brings:
🔄 A completely redesigned gameplay experience
🖥️ Improved user interface
🚚 Reworked logistics system: better route, vehicle, and platform management
🚀 Upgraded to Unity 6: better performance and a more stable technical foundation
[hr][/hr]🧪 End of the BETA:
The game is now out of the beta branch and becomes the main version on Steam.
[hr][/hr]🆕 Changes in this latest update:
✅ All license items can now be purchased
✅ Graphics settings optimized
✅ Various text and translation fixes
✅ "Open" panel state is now saved
✅ Uncle's messages are now saved
✅ Fixed slot initialization (truck + platform)
✅ Tutorial targets are now automatically removed once completed
✅ "Buy" buttons replaced with "Add to cart"
➕ New tutorial step: guide the player to the portal
➕ New unlockable items in the license menu
➕ New purchasable items in the store
[hr][/hr]🔮 What’s next?
This is just the beginning! Here’s what’s planned for future updates:

👥 Employee management
🧠 Deeper logistics system
🧱 Building renovation
📖 Story mode + quests
✉️ Post office system
🚚 New vehicles
🏗️ New delivery platforms
➕ And much more...
[hr][/hr]
This public release is a major milestone for the project, and your feedback is more valuable than ever.
Enjoy the game, and happy shipping! 🌊

notes.title: BETA UPDATE #2
notes.content:
🧪 BETA UPDATE #2 – Global Shipping Simulator
A new version is now available via the BETA branch on Steam

Following extensive community feedback, this second beta update brings a series of bug fixes, gameplay improvements, and tweaks to make the experience smoother and more intuitive.

✨ What’s changed:

🛠️ Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where a box could disappear when dropped in the store lobby

Music no longer turns back on automatically after restarting the game

The van camera now correctly starts above the vehicle, making it easier to control

Fullscreen settings no longer reset every time the settings menu is opened

The truck now keeps its contents when arriving at the logistics area

Tutorial progression is now correctly validated, even if the player opens the store from the inside

🎮 Quality of Life Improvements

You can now hold down the left mouse button to place multiple items faster

A directional arrow has been added to the minimap to help with navigation

Added borderless windowed mode in the display settings

Added a customizable keybinding system (currently in development)

🎓 Reworked Tutorial

Improved guidance after opening the store

Added a clear step instructing players to go to the packing room and start processing orders

💰 Adjusted Economy

Shelves now display a purchase price in the store system (in addition to shipping costs)

ℹ️ Additional Notes:

This version is still in BETA, with features actively being added and adjusted

Some UI elements or text may continue to evolve

💬 Thank you all!
Your feedback has a direct impact on development.
Please keep testing, reporting bugs, and sharing ideas.
Global Shipping Simulator is growing thanks to you ❤️

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE – Global Shipping Simulator
notes.content:
🛳️ MAJOR UPDATE – Global Shipping Simulator
New version now available via the BETA branch

After many player feedbacks, I made a bold decision: restart the game from scratch.
Today, Global Shipping Simulator is back with a new vision, new mechanics, and a completely rebuilt core gameplay.
⚠️ This revamped version is now available through the BETA branch on Steam.
[hr][/hr]✨ What’s new:
🔄 Gameplay redesigned from the ground up for a deeper and more strategic experience
🎮 Revamped interface for better clarity and smoother usability
🚀 Upgraded to Unity 6: improved performance, better visuals, and a solid foundation for the future
[hr][/hr]🧪 A BETA version in active development:
What you're playing today is the foundation of the new game.
The core is here, but there’s a lot more to come.

🧪 Please note:

This is a BETA, so some bugs or issues may occur

Certain texts may still be untranslated or temporary

Features are being added progressively over time

Your feedback is highly appreciated during this phase!
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Planned features for the future:
👥 Employee management: hire, train, and manage your staff
🚚 New vehicles
🏗️ New delivery platforms: different hub types, specialized warehouses
🧠 Improved logistics system: deeper optimization and management layers
📖 Story and quests: scripted events and narrative progression
✉️ Post office system: letters, parcels, custom delivery services
🧱 Building renovation: upgrade your infrastructure to improve efficiency
➕ And much more…
[hr][/hr]🔍 How to access the BETA:[olist]
Right-click on the game in your Steam Library

Select Properties

Go to the Betas tab

Choose the beta branch from the list

Close — Steam will automatically update the game
[/olist][hr][/hr]
Thank you to everyone who's still following the project.
This beta is just the beginning of a new journey, and I’m counting on your feedback to help shape the game moving forward!

— The Global Shipping Simulator team

notes.title: 📢 Major Update – Refocusing on Logistics! 🚛
notes.content:
Dear players,

Following your numerous requests, we have decided to adjust certain aspects of the game to better meet your expectations. The core objective of this project has always been managing a logistics factory, and we will now focus entirely on this aspect.

🔄 Major Changes (Requested by the Community)
Removal of the Post Office and Store 🏢✂️

Many of you pointed out that these features strayed from the core gameplay. To improve the experience and stay true to the game’s original vision, we have decided to remove them.
Complete Overhaul of the Logistics System 🔄

Based on your feedback, we have completely redesigned the logistics system to make it more realistic, smoother, and more engaging.
🏭 New Additions
New Items for the Logistics Factory 📦

More options and variety to optimize your supply chains!
Tutorial Overhaul 🎓

A better tutorial for a more intuitive and accessible experience.
Addition of Civilians in the Streets 🚶‍♂️🏙️

Your environment will now feel more alive with NPCs roaming the city.
🔧 Fixes and Optimizations
Optimization and fixes for the sleep system 💤⚙️
Fixed Chinese and Russian text translations 🌍📜
We truly appreciate your valuable feedback, which helps us improve the game continuously. Keep sharing your ideas—your suggestions shape the best possible experience! 🚀

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game! 🎮

notes.title: FPS Optimization & Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
🎮 FPS Optimization & Customization
✅ Added a customizable FPS limit in the options menu.
✅ Each player can now stabilize and adjust their FPS according to their preferences.
✅ Smoother gameplay: no more FPS fluctuations causing stuttering!

🖱 Fix: Mouse Sensitivity
 Fixed a bug where mouse sensitivity changed depending on FPS.

🗑 Improved Waste Disposal System
🔹 Before: Players had to hold the left click to destroy waste objects.
🔹 Now: A single click is enough to immediately send them to the trash.
✅ More fluid gameplay: No need to hold the click to dispose of light objects!

💬 Thank you for your feedback! Keep sharing your suggestions to help improve Global Shipping Simulator. 🚀🌍
